name: Camp Matoaka
description_short: Overnight summer camp for girls in Smithfield, Maine. For 2027 it offers two 3-week half sessions and a 7-week full session.
refund_policy_summary: The $3,000 deposit is fully refundable. The page does not give a refund policy for the rest of the tuition.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Camp Matoaka's Summer Camp Dates & Rates | Girls Summer Camp in ME

warnings: Extra costs on top of tuition: a $250 personal expense fee for half-session campers and $450 for full-session campers, a 3% fee on credit card payments made after the deposit, and nominal transportation fees.
The page footer says © 2025, but the dates are clearly marked as the 2027 season. The weekdays match the 2027 calendar.
Visiting Day for the Full Session is Sunday, July 18, 2027.
